mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.user_id AS userId, o.order_number AS orderNumber, o.status AS status, o.payment_status AS paymentStatus, o.total_price AS totalPrice, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS productCount, DATE_FORMAT(o.ordered_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS orderedAt FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN delivery_jobs dj ON dj.order_id = o.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.is_history_deleted = 0 GROUP BY o.id, o.user_id, o.order_number, o.status, dj.status, o.payment_status, o.total_price, o.ordered_at ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC

SELECT oi.id AS orderItemId, oi.order_id AS orderId, oi.product_id AS productId, oi.product_name AS productName, oi.product_image_url AS productImageUrl, oi.unit_price AS unitPrice, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.total_price AS totalPrice FROM order_items oi INNER JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} AND o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY oi.id ASC
SELECT address AS deliveryAddress, location_latitude AS deliveryLatitude, location_longitude AS deliveryLongitude FROM users WHERE id=#{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_addresses(user_id,receiver_name,receiver_phone,address,detail_address,default_yn,created_at) SELECT id,COALESCE(CONCAT_WS(' ',first_name,last_name),''),COALESCE(phone_number,''), #{deliveryAddress},'', 'N',NOW() FROM users WHERE id=#{userId}

INSERT INTO orders ( user_id, address_id, delivery_address, delivery_latitude, delivery_longitude, user_tariff_id, order_number, status, payment_status, subtotal_price, delivery_price, discount_price, total_price, ordered_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{addressId}, #{deliveryAddress}, #{deliveryLatitude}, #{deliveryLongitude}, #{tariffSubscriptionId}, CONCAT('ORD-', REPLACE(UUID(), '-', '')), 'PENDING', 'PENDING', #{subtotalPrice}, 0, #{discountPrice}, #{totalPrice}, NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO order_items ( order_id, product_id, product_name, product_image_url, unit_price, quantity, total_price, fiscal_mxik_code, fiscal_package_code, vat_percent, created_at ) SELECT #{orderId}, p.id, p.name, ( SELECT pi.image_url FROM product_images pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.sort_order ASC, pi.id ASC LIMIT 1 ), #{price}, #{quantity}, #{price} * #{quantity}, fm.mxik_code, fmp.package_code, p.vat_percent, NOW() FROM products p INNER JOIN fiscal_mxik_package fmp ON fmp.id = p.fiscal_mxik_package_id INNER JOIN fiscal_mxik fm ON fm.id = fmp.mxik_id WHERE p.id = #{productId} AND p.is_active = 1 AND p.vat_percent IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_tariffs WHERE id = #{tariffSubscriptionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND start_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date IS NOT NULL AND NOW() BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
SELECT id FROM user_tariffs WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND start_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date IS NOT NULL AND NOW() BETWEEN start_date AND end_date ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id AS productId, CAST(price AS SIGNED) AS price, CAST(subscription_price AS SIGNED) AS subscriptionPrice, stock_quantity AS stockQuantity FROM products WHERE id = #{productId} AND is_active = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE delivery_jobs SET status='CANCELLED', updated_at=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId}

UPDATE orders SET status_actor=CONCAT('CUSTOMER:',#{userId}),status_source='CUSTOMER',status_reason=#{reason}, status = 'CANCELLED', cancel_reason = #{reason}, cancelled_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND payment_status = 'PAID' AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_history_deleted = 0
SELECT id AS orderId, order_number AS orderNumber, payment_status AS paymentStatus FROM orders WHERE id = #{orderId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.order_number AS orderNumber, o.status AS status, o.payment_status AS paymentStatus, DATE_FORMAT(o.ordered_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS orderedAt, CASE WHEN o.delivered_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATE_FORMAT(o.delivered_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') END AS deliveredAt FROM orders o LEFT JOIN delivery_jobs dj ON dj.order_id = o.id WHERE o.id = #{orderId} AND o.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET is_history_deleted = 1, history_deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_history_deleted = 0 AND status IN ('DELIVERED', 'CANCELLED')
